purpose: Dallas final resilience and release-candidate QA gate: validate production behavior under rapid live-event churn, viewport changes, asset failures and authoritative corrections while preserving personalized identity and existing Gamecast truth.

releaseCandidateContract.identityAuthority: current official headshot lock plus DAL/roster.json identity and number
releaseCandidateContract.fallback: Existing non-personalized Gamecast remains authoritative and usable whenever personalized assets are missing, invalid, late or undecodable.

stressScenarios.required: Back-to-back authoritative plays preempt completed/stale choreography cleanly; no participant, celebration or football state leaks into the next play.
Repeated identical polls are idempotent and cannot restart action clips, duplicate footballs or reconsume signatures.
A personalized asset resolving after its authoritative play revision is stale cannot appear over the newer scene.
Decode failure removes only the affected personalized layer and preserves text, score, field state and authoritative event truth.
Desktop-to-mobile and orientation changes reproject the active scene without changing player identity, scale class, football ownership or play revision.
Returning from a hidden/background tab reconstructs current authoritative state rather than replaying elapsed celebrations.
A correction immediately invalidates an in-flight generic or verified signature celebration if its qualifying truth no longer exists.
Scenes beyond the authored participant budget preserve principal identities and authoritative information through deterministic fallback.

qaChecks.assert: Performance or asset pressure may reduce animation richness but can never substitute another player's face, number, skin-tone lock or personalized sequence.
Personalized rendering remains blocked when official-headshot appearance provenance is unresolved; no name-based appearance inference is permitted.
Camera, lighting, scale, foot anchor, alpha and number-orientation locks survive scene interruption, viewport reflow and fallback transitions.
Only the newest accepted authoritative revision may own personalized choreography for a play key.
Rapid pass/catch/fumble/recovery transitions never produce duplicate authoritative footballs, including during correction or fallback.
CeeDee Lamb nose-wipe and Von Miller DeSoto Shuffle are removed/preempted when a newer authoritative revision removes the qualifying first down or sack.
Repeated polls, rerenders, viewport changes and background resume cannot replay an already-consumed verified signature.
Reduced-motion mode communicates the same resolved player/event truth without requiring full motion and without altering signature qualification semantics.
Personalized rendering failure cannot mutate score, down, distance, possession, clock, play text or other authoritative Gamecast data.
All Dallas chibi runtime keys, QA state and fallback behavior remain NFL/DAL scoped and cannot write MLB, NHL or another NFL team's state.

acceptanceFixtures.assert: A Lamb catch followed immediately by the next snap clears prior catch/celebration state before rendering the new play.
Twenty identical snapshots of one authoritative revision yield one action consumption and at most one eligible celebration.
A late decoded player frame from revision N is discarded after revision N+1 owns the scene.
A corrupt personalized frame falls back without hiding or altering authoritative Gamecast content.
Active player identities, foot anchors and football ownership remain coherent through responsive reprojection.
Resume reconstructs the current play and does not replay elapsed Lamb nose-wipe, Miller DeSoto Shuffle or generic celebrations.
A first-down correction to short-of-line-to-gain preempts an in-flight Lamb nose-wipe and marks no stale signature consumption on corrected truth.
A sack correction removing Miller as qualifying sacker preempts DeSoto Shuffle and reconstructs the corrected participants.
A catch corrected to incompletion clears receiver ownership with no duplicate or lingering football.
Reduced-motion presentation preserves player/event identity and authoritative result while suppressing unnecessary motion.
Failure of one Dallas personalized asset never causes another Dallas player's appearance, number or signature to render in its place.
Executing all stress, correction and fallback fixtures performs no write to MLB or NHL assets, caches, state or behavior.
